subject: 4HB1
skill: Calculate cube surface area or volume from a stated edge length; supports surface-area/volume context only, not the full transport-rate point.

customQuiz.rationale: Preserve the two-mark arithmetic and explicit final-answer concession for both original parts. Prose model presentation and standalone selection remove original diagram/table/comparison scaffolding; no equivalent difficulty claim. Ratio and biological explanation are separate demands.

requirements: An original geometry model is explicitly a cube, not an actual cubical organism.
Supply one positive integer edge length in cm; ask only for area or volume.
Do not supply the target formula or the answer.
evidenceContract: Freeze seed, measure, edge, public question and private scheme before answering.
Source tasks, formula factors, exact result, unit and rubric remain private.
Public fields contain only prompt, given cube data and maximum marks.

constraints: Fresh generator excludes source edge 3; builder permits it for historical regression only.
Area and volume retain their own source task and unit; no ratio or inverse target.
Generated finite bank has only 38 distinct question forms; seeds repeat periodically.
No fractional edges, unit conversion, ratios, heat, transport-rate inference or multi-part dependency in this version.
Never activate from arithmetic or synthetic marking checks alone.
difficultyControls: Vary integer edge 1–20 without asserting equal demand.
Original two-cube diagram/table scaffolding is absent and needs explicit representation/difficulty calibration.

transformations.conditions: Recompute every answer and preserve the cube shape and stated cm units.
Review removal of original organism comparison, diagram and table before serving.
Ratio ecf and biological explanations require separate source/demand/marking review.

solutionProcedure: Identify whether area or volume is asked for.
Area: six faces, each edge squared. Volume: three edge factors.
Evaluate in the requested square or cubic centimetres.

criteria.rule: Source multiplication method: edge × edge × 6 for area, edge × edge × edge for volume.
Correct result. The source explicitly permits full marks for a correct final answer alone.

acceptableAlternatives: Commuted correct three-factor multiplication is supported by the bounded offline transcription marker.
Other equivalent algebraic/geometric methods and numeric notation require review rather than an automatic zero.
dependencies: Published ecf label retained privately; wrong-dimension and earlier-working pathways are not independently calibrated.
Do not manufacture a third unit mark or transplant the ratio part scoring concession.
contradictionRules: Additional evidence, competing answers, correct final with conflicting evaluation, and correct working with missing/different final are deferred.
marking.units: cm² for area; cm³ for volume

tolerance.roundingRule: Exact integer outputs. Unsupported precision/notation or unit issues require review; no blanket alternative-unit deduction.

commonErrors.description: Use volume factors when asked for total surface area, or omit six faces.
